release_commit_note: The release commit is recorded by Git history; embedding the containing commit would create a self-referential hash.
summary: Corrected placement of Related News: it now also renders inline in the main narrative summary (the section most readers actually scroll through), immediately after each authority's Practical Interpretation list, in addition to the existing Source Register accordion copy. Previously (v1.2.0-1.3.0) Related News rendered only inside the Source Register's collapsed per-record cards, which the user reported as effectively undiscoverable during real use. Implementation: a `<span class="news-anchor" data-record-id="XX-000" hidden>` marker placed after the relevant `### heading` in each state's XX_UAS_Regulatory_Summary.md; docs/app.js's new injectNewsIntoNarrative() matches it to the record and inserts the same news block used in the Source Register right after that record's .perspectives-list. build_data.py now warns at build time if a record has news but no matching narrative anchor. Anchors added for all 5 currently-live news items (TX-006, TX-008, TX-012, OR-002, OR-004). agents/roles/web-ux-ui-editor.md bumped to 1.4.0 to document the corrected placement requirement.
